description: Narendra Deoram Jejurkar Mathematics Educator & Student Counselor I believe that a strong foundation in Mathematics is the gateway to a student’s future success. With 25 years of experience in the field of education, my mission has always been to simplify complex concepts and help students overcome their fear of numbers.  As the founder of Shree Jay Gajanan Classes in Nashik, I specialize in teaching Mathematics for students in SSC & HSC boards. My approach goes beyond the textbook; I act as a counselor and mentor, guiding my students through their academic challenges and helping them build the confidence they need to excel in their board exams and beyond.  How I Can Help Targeted Coaching: Comprehensive math preparation for 10th and 12th standards.  Expert Guidance: 25 years of insights into student psychology and academic performance.  Consistent Support: I am available every day to ensure students stay on track with their goals.  Get In Touch I invite you to visit my center for a consultation to discuss your child’s academic journey.  Address: Shop No. 7, Rajiv Complex, Rajiv Nagar, Nashik.  Office Hours: 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM (Available All Days)
